explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows hydroxocobalamin injection from BTG International Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. as Current since 2024-11-04; our supply traces to a label naming Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. as the manufacturing plant

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows hydroxocobalamin injection from BTG International Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. as Current, first posted 2024-11-04 and updated 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-15 respectively.
The shortage has been on FDA's list for 24 months as of 2026-10-21.

Our inventory at both Corvale East and Corvale General carries NDC 00591288830 labeled by Actavis Pharma, Inc., and the product label names Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. 2705-906 Terrugem SNT as the manufacturing plant.
Corvale East has 5.1 days on hand (20 vials at 3.9 vials per day) and Corvale General has 18.7 days on hand (75 vials at 4 vials per day).
The top-ranked action is to transfer 18 vials of 1000 ug/mL, 30 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave Corvale General with 14 days and bring Corvale East to 10 days.

rejected.text: There is no public FDA inspection classification (OAI, VAI, or NAI) or other signal for that plant in the evidence provided.
